note: Burkina Faso: nationals of the ECOWAS states, Mali, Niger and the UAE enter without a visa, those of the Central African Republic, Mauritania and Morocco for 90 days, Singapore's for 30, Hong Kong's for 14 (by Hong Kong's Immigration Department); US nationals are refused (taken as a visa); everyone else needs a visa from a mission or online (taken as an e-Visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Burkina Faso
sources.said: Visitors to Burkina Faso must obtain a visa from one of the Burkina Faso diplomatic missions or online, unless they come from one of the visa exempt countries or a country whose citizens may obtain a visa on arrival. ... Citizens of the following 19 countries can visit Burkina Faso without a visa: All ECOWAS member states Central African Republic (90 days) Hong Kong Mali Mauritania (90 days) Morocco (90 days) Niger Singapore (30 days) United Arab Emirates ... According to the Hong Kong Immigration Department, citizens of Hong Kong can enter Burkina Faso without a visa for 14 days. ... refused to United States nationals
